items.prompt: Afirin Ridge moves a road during early works. A gate count covers dry weekdays and excludes vendors travelling on wet-season market days. Give five corrections before the route decision.
items.model_answer: Map affected users outside the project boundary. Set a comparable seasonal baseline. Trace the access and earnings pathway. Offer safe participation and show how input will influence the decision. Assign the assessment review and date.

items.prompt: Prepare a phased response to a fictional project winding down at Afirin Ridge. A fence may remove access to seasonal land and a clinic route, informal vendors are excluded from the transition plan, and a complainant fears retaliation. The operator promises a district training hall and cites its well-attended meeting. Use all eight EIL courses and specify what evidence could change the decision.
items.model_answer: Map affected groups and project stage. Compare matched access baselines, impact pathways and alternatives. Address paid and informal livelihoods and transition quality. Set protected referral and authorised environmental review. Compare avoidance, restoration and benefits separately. Give a safe grievance route and independent review. Reconcile commitments with delivery. Recommend bounded steps, owners, trigger and retest.

items.prompt: Review Afirin Ridge’s statement that the closure transition is fair and complete. It cites a gate traffic count, training certificates, an environmental report from another location, compensation forms, a closed-complaint count and promised funds. A simulated transport trial failed low-access users. Use all eight EIL courses to explain the limits, propose better evidence and defend the next action.
items.model_answer: Describe whose participation and stage are visible. Compare route boundaries and outcome evidence. Verify seasonal and sustained livelihoods and reasons for missing coverage. Separate historical or site evidence and clinical support. Review eligible loss, access and benefits. Examine remedy outcomes and protected review. Trace promised funds and actual use. Keep failed trial cases visible and attach a justified corrective decision.
